Leaf shader compiles with wind/contact deformation and active LOD fades in camera, directional and point shadow passes

limits: One Windows/AMD Radeon 860M/Chrome configuration; other GPUs and mobile devices unmeasured.
Blocking frame samples are diagnostics, not sustained interactive FPS or a dense-forest benchmark.
Uniform thin-sheet approximation; no painted thickness maps, canopy occlusion/GI, cascaded shadows, temporal antialiasing or streaming.
The adapted study retains reduced geometry and 512px model textures. Passing checks does not establish photorealistic production readiness.
